newsitem.title: USA: Payco American holders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Payco American holders approve merger.

text.p: Payco American Corp said shareholders on Monday approved the previously announced plan of merger among Payco, Outsourcing Solutions Inc (formerly OSI Holdings Corp) and Boxer Acquisition Corp.

Under terms of the agreement, once the merger becomes effective, each share of Payco common stock will be converted into the right to receive $14 in cash, without interest and less any applicable withholding taxes.
The transaction, which creates the largest accounts receivables management company in the United States, is expected to close on November 6, Payco said.
